words.explain: Air is all around us. We can't see it, but we breathe it all the time.
words.sentence: 公园里的空气很新鲜。
words.sentencePinyin: gōng yuán lǐ de kōng qì hěn xīn xiān.

words.explain: Rocks are big, hard pieces of stone on hills and beaches.
words.sentence: 海边有很多大岩石。
words.sentencePinyin: hǎi biān yǒu hěn duō dà yán shí.

words.explain: Woods are places where lots of trees grow close together.
words.sentence: 小鸟在树林里唱歌。
words.sentencePinyin: xiǎo niǎo zài shù lín lǐ chàng gē.

words.explain: A lawn is a big patch of soft green grass.
words.sentence: 小朋友在草地上踢球。
words.sentencePinyin: xiǎo péng you zài cǎo dì shàng tī qiú.

words.explain: A garden is a place where people grow pretty flowers and plants.
words.sentence: 花园里开满了美丽的花。
words.sentencePinyin: huā yuán lǐ kāi mǎn le měi lì de huā.

words.explain: Stars are the tiny lights that twinkle in the night sky.
words.sentence: 天上的星星一闪一闪的。
words.sentencePinyin: tiān shàng de xīng xing yì shǎn yì shǎn de.

words.explain: The moon shines in the sky at night. Sometimes it is round, sometimes it is thin.
words.sentence: 今天晚上的月亮又大又圆。
words.sentencePinyin: jīn tiān wǎn shang de yuè liàng yòu dà yòu yuán.

words.explain: A rainbow is the colourful arch you see in the sky after rain.
words.sentence: 雨后，天上有一道彩虹。
words.sentencePinyin: yǔ hòu, tiān shàng yǒu yí dào cǎi hóng.

words.explain: The sun is a big, hot star that gives us light and keeps us warm.
words.sentence: 太阳出来了，天气很暖和。
words.sentencePinyin: tài yáng chū lái le, tiān qì hěn nuǎn huo.

words.explain: When it rains, little drops of water fall from the clouds.
words.sentence: 下雨了，我们要带雨伞。
words.sentencePinyin: xià yǔ le, wǒ men yào dài yǔ sǎn.

words.explain: The countryside is the open land outside the city, with fields and trees.
words.sentence: 周末，我们去郊外玩。
words.sentencePinyin: zhōu mò, wǒ men qù jiāo wài wán.

words.explain: Dark clouds are big grey clouds. They often bring rain.
words.sentence: 天上有很多乌云，快要下雨了。
words.sentencePinyin: tiān shàng yǒu hěn duō wū yún, kuài yào xià yǔ le.

words.explain: We open an umbrella to stay dry when it rains.
words.sentence: 下雨了，妈妈给我打伞。
words.sentencePinyin: xià yǔ le, mā ma gěi wǒ dǎ sǎn.

words.explain: When it is windy, the air moves fast and the trees sway.
words.sentence: 外面在刮风，树叶都在跳舞。
words.sentencePinyin: wài miàn zài guā fēng, shù yè dōu zài tiào wǔ.

words.explain: Lightning is a bright flash of light in the sky during a storm.
words.sentence: 天空中有一道闪电。
words.sentencePinyin: tiān kōng zhōng yǒu yí dào shǎn diàn.

words.explain: When it is sunny and clear, the sky is blue and there is no rain.
words.sentence: 今天天气晴朗，我们去公园玩。
words.sentencePinyin: jīn tiān tiān qì qíng lǎng, wǒ men qù gōng yuán wán.

words.explain: Cold weather makes us shiver, so we wear warm clothes.
words.sentence: 冬天很寒冷，我要穿上厚衣服。
words.sentencePinyin: dōng tiān hěn hán lěng, wǒ yào chuān shàng hòu yī fu.

words.explain: Very hot weather makes us sweat and want a cold drink.
words.sentence: 天气炎热，我喝了很多水。
words.sentencePinyin: tiān qì yán rè, wǒ hē le hěn duō shuǐ.

words.explain: A calendar shows the days, weeks and months of the year.
words.sentence: 我在日历上找到了我的生日。
words.sentencePinyin: wǒ zài rì lì shàng zhǎo dào le wǒ de shēng rì.

words.explain: Time tells us when things happen. A clock shows us the time.
words.sentence: 时间到了，我们去上学吧。
words.sentencePinyin: shí jiān dào le, wǒ men qù shàng xué ba.

words.explain: The moon is a big ball of rock that goes around the Earth.
words.sentence: 我们可以从地球上看到月球。
words.sentencePinyin: wǒ men kě yǐ cóng dì qiú shàng kàn dào yuè qiú.

words.explain: Earth is the planet we live on. It is round like a ball.
words.sentence: 我们住在地球上。
words.sentencePinyin: wǒ men zhù zài dì qiú shàng.

words.explain: A comet is an icy ball in space with a long, shiny tail.
words.sentence: 彗星有一条长长的尾巴。
words.sentencePinyin: huì xīng yǒu yì tiáo cháng cháng de wěi ba.

words.explain: Neptune is a blue planet very, very far away from the sun.
words.sentence: 海王星是一颗蓝色的星球。
words.sentencePinyin: hǎi wáng xīng shì yì kē lán sè de xīng qiú.

words.explain: Uranus is a cold, blue-green planet that spins on its side.
words.sentence: 天王星离我们很远很远。
words.sentencePinyin: tiān wáng xīng lí wǒ men hěn yuǎn hěn yuǎn.

words.explain: Protecting the environment means keeping our Earth clean and green.
words.sentence: 我们要环保，不乱扔垃圾。
words.sentencePinyin: wǒ men yào huán bǎo, bú luàn rēng lā jī.

words.explain: The universe is everything in space: the stars, the planets and more.
words.sentence: 宇宙里有很多很多星星。
words.sentencePinyin: yǔ zhòu lǐ yǒu hěn duō hěn duō xīng xing.

words.explain: We use water to drink, wash and cook. We should not waste it.
words.sentence: 我们用水要节约。
words.sentencePinyin: wǒ men yòng shuǐ yào jié yuē.

words.explain: The environment is the world around us: the air, water, land and living things.
words.sentence: 我们要保护美丽的环境。
words.sentencePinyin: wǒ men yào bǎo hù měi lì de huán jìng.

words.explain: Rubbish is the things we throw away. It goes in the bin.
words.sentence: 请把垃圾扔进垃圾桶。
words.sentencePinyin: qǐng bǎ lā jī rēng jìn lā jī tǒng.

words.explain: The night sky is the dark sky we see at night, full of stars.
words.sentence: 夜空中有很多星星。
words.sentencePinyin: yè kōng zhōng yǒu hěn duō xīng xing.

words.explain: A myth is a very old story about gods, heroes or magic.
words.sentence: 爷爷给我讲了一个神话故事。
words.sentencePinyin: yé ye gěi wǒ jiǎng le yí gè shén huà gù shi.

words.explain: Space travel means flying a rocket up into space.
words.sentence: 我长大了想当航天员。
words.sentencePinyin: wǒ zhǎng dà le xiǎng dāng háng tiān yuán.

words.explain: An alien is a make-believe creature from another planet.
words.sentence: 我画了一个可爱的外星人。
words.sentencePinyin: wǒ huà le yí gè kě ài de wài xīng rén.

words.explain: A telescope makes things that are far away look big and close.
words.sentence: 我用望远镜看星星。
words.sentencePinyin: wǒ yòng wàng yuǎn jìng kàn xīng xing.
